children.innerHTML: Three engagements told properly. The rest on request; clients get to keep some things to themselves.

attributes.alt: Fold, brand objects, shot in studio

children.innerHTML: Fold, brand objects, shot in studio
A flat-pack furniture maker with a good product and a forgettable name. We renamed it, rebuilt the identity around the fold itself and photographed the range like sculpture, because it earned it.

attributes.alt: Marrow, work in progress at the bench

children.innerHTML: Marrow, work in progress at the bench
A neighbourhood bakery growing into three rooms. One typeface, one clay tone, paper bags worth keeping. The interior does the advertising; the bread does the rest.

attributes.alt: Sonder, light study for the north stair

children.innerHTML: Sonder, light study for the north stair
Forty corridors, four buildings, one system. Signs that read at a glance, age with the building and never shout. The hardest work here is everything you don't notice.
